articles.title: No surprise: Kim Jong Un re-elected as head of North Korea's Workers' Party
articles.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has been re-elected as the General Secretary of the ruling Workers' Party during a rare congress, solidifying his control. This move, reported by state media, is a key political step to legitimize his leadership and reinforces his authoritarian grip on the reclusive nation, signaling continuity in its internal and external policies.

articles.title: 'God Has Given Me A Theek-Thaak Face'
articles.summary: Veteran actress Deepti Naval recently expressed her strong conviction about embracing natural aging, stating she is content showing her age and has no desire to look twenty years younger. She affirmed her decision against cosmetic surgery, highlighting a personal philosophy of self-acceptance and authenticity in an industry often pressured by youth and artificial enhancements.
